dealSummary: Moove, the developer of an operating layer for autonomous fleet management, raised a $250 million Series C led by Mubadala, Woven Capital, Toyota’s Growth Fund and Ion Pacific at a $2.1 billion valuation.
leadInvestors: Mubadala, Woven Capital, Toyota’s Growth Fund, Ion Pacific

dealSummary: India-based EV startup River secured a $120 million Series C led by Elev8 Venture Partners and Claypond Capital.
Expedition Therapeutics, a biopharma company developing therapies for inflammatory and respiratory diseases, received a $115 million Series B led by General Atlantic.
Faye, the developer of a travel protection platform, raised a $50 million Series C led by Madrona.
Defense tech startup Aurelius Systems, which builds directed-energy laser systems to counter drone threats, received a $40 million Series A led by Draper Associates and KAS Venture Partners.
WindBorne Systems, which builds a global network of weather forecasting sensing balloons, raised a $37 million Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize.
Berlin-based AI finance startup Moss raised a €30 million Series C at a €1 billion valuation, Sifted reported.
InRisk Labs, a climate-tech startup, raised a $27 million round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital.
Portuguese space traffic management startup Neuraspace secured €15.6 million in a round led by Lince Capital, Explorer Investments and Armilar Venture Partners.
leadInvestors: Lince Capital, Explorer Investments, Armilar Venture Partners
